author: nickyeow

english.text: As I am off duty today, let's go to the beach.

jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 sai2 dong1 zik6 aa3，bat1 jyu4 jat1 cai4 heoi3 saa1 taan1 waan2 aa1。
text: 我今日唔使當值呀，不如一齊去沙灘玩吖。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You shouldn't talk about people behind their backs.

jyutping: nei5 m4 jing1 goi1 hai2 bui3 hau6 gong2 jan4 waai6 waa6。
text: 你唔應該喺背後講人壞話。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you have a double room?

jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 man6 haa2 jau5 mou5 soeng1 jan4 fong2 aa3？
text: 我想問吓有冇雙人房呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I had my hair cut at the barber's.
I had my hair cut at a barber's shop.

jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 zo2 faat3 jing4 uk1 zin2 tau4 faat3。
text: 我去咗髮型屋剪頭髮。

author: nickyeow

english.text: My dad gives me a weekly allowance that I use to buy comics and ice cream.

jyutping: ngo5 aa3 baa4 mui5 go3 lai5 baai3 dou1 wui5 bei2 di1 ling4 jung6 cin2 ngo5，ngo5 zau6 wui5 lo2 di1 ling4 jung6 cin2 heoi3 maai5 maan6 waa2 tai2 tung4 maai4 maai5 syut3 gou1 sik6。
text: 我阿爸每個禮拜都會俾啲零用錢我，我就會攞啲零用錢去買漫畫睇同埋買雪糕食。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Some college teachers come to class late and leave early.

jyutping: jau5 di1 daai6 hok6 gaau3 sau6 hou2 zung1 ji3 ci4 lai4 zou2 zau2。
text: 有啲大學教授好鍾意遲嚟早走。

author: fercheung

english.text: Kyiv is the capital of Ukraine.

jyutping: gei1 fu6 hai6 wu1 hak1 laan4 ge3 sau2 dou1。
text: 基輔係烏克蘭嘅首都。

author: fercheung

english.text: They released the prisoner.

jyutping: keoi5 dei6 fong3 zo2 go2 go3 faan6 jan4。
text: 佢哋放咗嗰個犯人。

author: fercheung

english.text: That can't be true.

jyutping: mou5 ho2 nang4 hai6 zan1 ge3。
text: 冇可能係真嘅。

author: kaenif

english.text: Don't slip on the ice.

jyutping: m4 hou2 hai2 bing1 soeng6 min6 sin2 can1 aa3。
text: 唔好喺冰上面跣親呀。

author: kaenif

english.text: I would like to learn how to dance.

jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 hok6 tiu3 mou5。
text: 我想學跳舞。

author: nickyeow

english.text: To my knowledge, she hasn't married yet.

jyutping: geoi3 ngo5 so2 zi1，keoi5 jing1 goi1 zung6 mei6 git3 fan1。
text: 據我所知，佢應該仲未結婚。

author: nickyeow

english.text: That famous poet planned on killing himself in his library.

jyutping: go3 ceot1 ming4 ge3 si1 jan4 gai3 waak6 hai2 keoi5 gaan1 syu1 fong2 dou3 zi6 saat3。
text: 個出名嘅詩人計劃喺佢間書房到自殺。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you really mean that?

jyutping: nei5 jing2 zan1 gaa3？
text: 你認真㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: He disagreed with his father.

jyutping: keoi5 m4 tung4 ji3 keoi5 aa3 baa4 ge3 gong2 faat3。
text: 佢唔同意佢阿爸嘅講法。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I refused to believe what they told me.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 hang2 soeng1 seon3 keoi5 dei6 waa6 bei2 ngo5 teng1 ge3 je5。
text: 我唔肯相信佢哋話俾我聽嘅嘢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Who's funding the project?

jyutping: go3 gai3 waak6 hai6 bin1 go3 zi1 zo6 gaa3？
text: 個計劃係邊個資助㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Sorry, I mistook you for someone else.

jyutping: deoi3 m4 zyu6，ngo5 jing6 co3 jan4。
text: 對唔住，我認錯人。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I opened the can, but it was empty.

jyutping: ngo5 daa2 hoi1 zo2 go3 gun3，daan6 hai6 jap6 min6 me1 dou1 mou5。

author: nickyeow

english.text: There's no money left in my bank account.

jyutping: ngo5 go3 ngan4 hong4 wu6 hau2 mou5 cin4 zing6。
text: 我個銀行戶口冇錢淨。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Can I use a credit card?

jyutping: sau1 m4 sau1 kaa1 gaa3？
text: 收唔收卡㗎？

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I won't be able to help you today.

jyutping: gam1 jat6 bong1 m4 dou3 sau2 bo3。
text: 今日幫唔到手噃。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: On an uneventful 6th of November of 2021, I was drinking my iced green tea at the cafe. I had to line up for it; ahead of me was a handsome man in a dark jacket. A chunky dark man with a shaven head came in. Outside, through the window, I could see a virile man in white with big pectorals go to and from the nearby bank. Two girly men were sitting at a table beyond mine. The Westerners were really cynical, I noticed.

jyutping: hai2 2021 nin4 11 jyut6 6 hou6，ngo5 hai2 gaa3 fe1 teng1 jam2 gan2 ngo5 ge3 bing1 luk6 caa4。ngo5 jiu3 paai4 deoi2 dang2 keoi5；ngo5 cin4 min6 jau5 go3 leng3 zai2，zoek3 zyu6 gin6 sam1 sik1 ngoi6 tou3。jat1 go3 tai3 gwong1 tau4 ge3 cou1 hak1 naam4 jan2 jap6 lai4，ceot1 min2，tau3 gwo3 coeng1 hau2，ngo5 ho2 ji5 gin3 dou2 jat1 go3 naam4 jan2 mei6 sap6 zuk1 ge3 baak6 saam1，hung1 daai6，loi4 wui4 fu6 gan6 ge3 ngon6 bin1。loeng5 go3 neoi5 zai2 zo6 hai2 ngo5 gaak3 lei4 zoeng1 toi2 dou6。ngo5 lau4 ji3 dou3，sai1 fong1 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 fan5 sai3 zat6 zuk6。
text: 喺2021年11月6號，我喺咖啡廳飲緊我嘅冰綠茶。我要排隊等佢；我前面有個靚仔，着住件深色外套。一個剃光頭嘅粗黑男人入嚟，出面，透過窗口，我可以見到一個男人味十足嘅白衫，胸大，來回附近嘅岸邊。兩個女仔坐喺我隔籬張枱度。我留意到，西方人真係好憤世嫉俗。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Inwardly the Second Men differed from the earlier species in that they had shed most of those primitive relics which had hampered the First Men more than was realized. Not only were they free of appendix, tonsils and other useless excrescences, but also their whole structure was more firmly knit into unity. Their chemical organization was such that their tissues were kept in better repair. Their teeth, though proportionately small and few, were almost completely immune from caries. Such was their glandular equipment that puberty did not begin till twenty; and not till they were fifty did they reach maturity. At about one hundred and ninety their powers began to fail, and after a few years of contemplative retirement they almost invariably died before true senility could begin.

jyutping: hai2 noi6 sam1，dai6 ji6 go3 naam4 jan2 tung4 zou2 kei4 ge3 mat6 zung2 m4 tung4，jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 diu6 zo2 daai6 bou6 fan6 jyun4 ci2 ge3 wai4 mat6，ni1 di1 wai4 mat6 zo2 ngoi6 zo2 dai6 jat1 go3 naam4 jan2，keoi5 dei6 m4 daan1 zi2 mou5 fu6 suk6 tai2、bin2 tou4 sin3 tung4 kei4 taa1 mou4 jung6 ge3 paai4 sit3 mat6，ji4 ce2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 zing2 go3 git3 kau3 gang3 gaa1 gan2 mat6 gam2 git3 hap6 maai4 jat1 cai4，keoi5 dei6 ge3 faa3 hok6 zou2 zik1 hai6 bou2 ci4 hai2 gang3 hou2 ge3 zong6 taai3，daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 ngaa4 ci2 gei1 fu4 mou5 gam3 sai3 hoi1 ci2 dou3 ji6 sap6 seoi3；zik6 dou3 keoi5 dei6 ng5 sap6 seoi3 sin1 dou3 sing4 suk6。daai6 joek3 jat1 baak3 gau2 sap6 seoi3 go2 zan6，keoi5 dei6 ge3 kyun4 lik6 hoi1 ci2 sat1 haau6，ging1 gwo3 gei2 nin4 ge3 cam4 si1 teoi3 jau1 zi1 hau6，keoi5 dei6 gei1 fu4 wing5 jyun5 dou1 wui5 hai2 zan1 zing3 ge3 seoi1 lou5 hoi1 ci2 zi1 cin4 sei2 zo2。
text: 喺內心，第二個男人同早期嘅物種唔同，因為佢哋掉咗大部分原始嘅遺物，呢啲遺物阻礙咗第一個男人，佢哋唔單止冇附屬體、扁桃腺同其他無用嘅排泄物，而且佢哋嘅整個結構更加緊密噉結合埋一齊，佢哋嘅化學組織係保持喺更好嘅狀態，但係佢哋嘅牙齒幾乎冇咁細開始到二十歲；直到佢哋五十歲先到成熟。大約一百九十歲嗰陣，佢哋嘅權力開始失效，經過幾年嘅沉思退休之後，佢哋幾乎永遠都會喺真正嘅衰老開始之前死咗。
